_comment: GOLDEN 2026-07-29 all-on DELTA — shared arm set, NO station roster.
Never load this file directly; it is an 'extends' base.  Compose as:
"extends": [<roster config>, <this file>]   (child + later base wins)
Arms, by group:
* user request      GPS+Galileo, frequency_mode/channel_mode = all, 10 deg mask,
all hardware-bias estimation, MW + IF-phase slip detectors,
cold-start clock seed, MW AR decision tiers.
* hardware bias     network.estimate_sat_code_bias = true is the COUPLED SLICE:
the loader forces estimate_sat_biases + promote_sat_code_bias +
estimate_ifb (rx DCB) + iono constraint + estimate_phase_clock=false
+ enable_code_phase_bias=false (own per-signal OSB replaces .BIA).
enable_code_phase_bias is therefore set false EXPLICITLY here.
* non-negotiables   estimate_iono_sh + phase_datum_prioritized + zero-q leveling with a
wired slip detector + 10 deg mask (feedback_network_nonnegotiable_configs).
* standard armed    raim / raim_attribution / raim_within_epoch / raim_withhold_sigma0 6.0 /
set (CLAUDE.md)   clock_runaway_check / sh_health_gate / phase_leveling / emit_ura /
code_bias_disc_jump_test / cb_excursion_reinit / cold_clock_seed /
pcarry ON + preduce OFF (mutex) / full observability.
* raim_we_code_iono ARMED — this run is its first ON exercise (code + iono-constraint
within-epoch pools, previously screened by no tier).
DELIBERATE OMISSIONS (each has a measured reason; do not 'complete' the set):
- mw_wl.fix_enable / wl_inject_enable / ewl_fold_rows / uwl_cold_fix / lane_carry.*
MW(1,2) is 1.6-1.9% wrong at every baseline and the WL bridge needs DD iono to
0.198 m; on a global roster ~83% of gate-admitted WL integers are wrong.  Integer
injection would corrupt the very health read this config exists to produce.
- mw_wl.uwl_family_pairs / mw_wl.lane_trace: INERT without lane_carry.  Gating is
uwl_family_on = uwl_on && lane_on && ... (ApplicationNetwork.cpp:528) and
mw_lane_trace = (wl_inject_on || lane_fix_on) && ... (:600).  Left off rather than
armed-and-dead (standing invariant #4).
- warmup_ura_floor_m: deadlocks against sh_health_gate — NetworkSolPrep.cpp:140
early-returns on sh_gate_engaged but the ramp-lift eval (:400) is downstream, so the
floor can never lift.
- emit_clock_rate / clock_model: net-harmful (c0 is a random walk, ZOH is MMSE) and no
RWFM in this fixture (Hadamard p~1).
- cycle_slip.turbo_edit: GF/TurboEdit is a 1 s real-time instrument; at 30 s the
detector set is relaxed MW + LLI + IF-TD (feedback_slip_detectors_by_rate).
- ocean-tide loading / atmospheric loading / higher-order iono: no EOT20 grid in
data/static/nc, no APL grid, and HOI would need an external GIM.
- estimate_glonass / GLONASS IFB: GPS+Galileo run, and estimate_glonass collapses
Galileo clocks at scale.
- ambiguity_resolution.enable: the network producer is float-only by design.
SH gate posture: the default a00 band [2, 150] TECU violates standing invariant #5
(a00 is the field's DC term, trades against the code-bias common mode, so its LEVEL is
a property of convergence history and two realizations of the same day differ by ~25
TECU).  Demoted here to the ruled wide backstop rail [-60, +200] with sh_gate_min_epochs
= 10 so the cold-start transient is not gated as a fault.  The ruled SHAPE gate (rms over
degrees >= 1 as a ratio to a converged-window median) is not built.
